import json, subprocess, sys, time
# adversarial: long names (127 labels), long CNAME chains, 20 queries x 8 profiles
def longname(i):
    labels = [chr(ord('a') + (i % 26))] * 127
    return '.'.join(labels) + '.'
recs = []
N = 66
for i in range(N):
    recs.append({"owner": longname(i), "type": "CNAME", "data": longname(i+1)})
# extra filler records to reach ~1024 entries
for i in range(900):
    recs.append({"owner": longname(200+i), "type": "TXT", "data": "x"*256})
zones = [{"origin": "z.", "records": recs}]
profiles = [{"id":"p%d"%i,"max_aliases":64,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"} for i in range(8)]
queries = [{"id":"q%d"%i,"name":longname(0),"type":"A","cost":1} for i in range(20)]
doc = {"zones":zones,"profiles":profiles,"queries":queries,"observations":[]}
raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
print('input bytes', len(raw))
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
print('elapsed %.2fs' % (time.time()-t), 'rc', p.returncode, 'outlen', len(p.stdout))
out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('runs', len(out['runs']), 'first run trace len', len(out['runs'][0]['trace']), 'ans', len(out['runs'][0]['answer']))
print('termination', out['runs'][0]['termination'], out['runs'][0]['rcode'])
PYEOF
